title: Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit Protocol: Final Clean-Up
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Final Clean-Up With this protocol, your [OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters for the Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit final clean‑up in the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file from the Opentrons interface.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Verify OT App version
steps.instruction: Confirm that the OT‑2 Run App is version 3.15.0 or later before proceeding.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map for the final clean‑up.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT‑2 App; consult the calibration support articles if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated final bead clean‑up.

steps.title: Collect final library
steps.instruction: When the run finishes, each sample will contain 20 μl of elution that holds the final library.
